Hello Everybody! 
I’m Kate, founder of Get Up & Go Education and Get Up & Go Sports Therapy.

On this channel I share:
• practical massage and bodywork education
• therapist business guidance
• client care and professional boundaries
• treatment room tips and tools
• honest conversations about building a sustainable practice

My approach combines therapeutic bodywork with a holistic understanding of the body, creating treatments that feel professional, grounded, and client-centred.

Whether you’re a massage student, newly qualified therapist, or growing your own practice, this channel is here to support your journey with clear, realistic, experience-based teaching.

World Massage Champion 2024
European Massage Champion 2023
Advanced Massage Teacher 2026
Level 5 Clinical Sports Therapist
Sound therapy practitioner
